description: This file implements reflection and registry management for command-line flags in the Abseil library, including classes and functions for flag registration, lookup, and retirement.

classes.name: FlagRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration and lookup of command-line flags.

classes.name: FlagRegistryLock
classes.description: RAII class for locking and unlocking the FlagRegistry.

classes.name: RetiredFlagObj
classes.description: Special class representing a retired flag, preventing access.

classes.name: FlagSaverImpl
classes.description: Implements saving and restoring flag states for FlagSaver.

methods.name: FindFlag
methods.description: Finds a flag by name in the registry.

methods.name: RegisterFlag
methods.description: Registers a new flag in the registry.

methods.name: GlobalRegistry
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FlagRegistry.

methods.name: Retire
methods.description: Marks a flag as retired, creating a placeholder object.
